notes.title: Major Update 0.67
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=q54CKA8tWGk;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










New level : [b]THE SWAMP[/b]
- a new difficult level full of traps
- with new enemies : The Undead
- one unique event
- and 2 new bosses : The "B" brothers

Others addin or fixes :
- Added starting resource items for the witch
- Changes around potions (cost and skills)
- Secured save system
- Updated the loot of chests, enemies and bosses
- less empty and more lively levels

notes.title: Major Update 0.66
notes.notes:
- Added a new mode: [b]Exploration[/b]
This mode allows the player to freely explore the chosen level, harvest and build whatever he wants. The crystal is immortal. All hero skills are unlocked. And finally there are no more invasions or bosses.
However, this mode does not provide any bonuses.

- Fixed a bug that prevented loading a save game containing a monster hunt
- Changes in AI behaviors of enemy units
- Added ring descriptions
- Addition of graphic elements in the inventory and status menus for more readability
- Fixed various bugs
